analysis.visual_description: A fresh quarto in your hands at the stall, the cloister behind you, a short drizzle on the flags and not on the page. Your right thumb rests on the margin.
The same quarto, open early. On the page a king rides captive behind his cousin, and a woman watches from a window. The thumb taps four beats and stops. No leaf is turned past the first book.
The quarto is closed and set down on Waterson's board. Harrison is in his own doorway. You have no wrapped book under your arm.
